title: Delta Air Lines: February 2026 Air Travel Consumer Report: December 2025 Operating Data
summary: DOT's February 2026 report supplies December 2025 operating-carrier records, on-time and cancellation percentages, and five delay-cause categories. Entity test: The repeat record shows movement across several reported categories but cannot isolate one explanation or represent a full-year outcome.
key_findings: The monthly operating-carrier table provides a compatible cause-mix observation for Delta, Southwest, and United.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests weather, airport and national-system exposure, maintenance or staffing, network structure, and late-aircraft recovery alternatives.
Compatibility: Same reporting operating carrier and monthly delay table; brand-level complaints may include partner-operated flights and use a separate denominator.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: One month is not a full-year result, and carrier-reported cause categories do not independently prove why performance changed.
Official common-table observations; causal attribution and commitment delivery remain unverified.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
